name: negotiate

on_enter.prompt: Say you are calling about a late payment and state each item from the facts in one sentence each.

function.name: create_promise
function.description: Record one promise. CALL it only after the customer said yes to the read-back.

item_ref.description: item_ref from the facts, copied unchanged.

amount_minor.description: Amount in currency units as read back, e.g. 412.50.

function.name: add_note
function.description: Record why an item has no promise. CALL it once per item without a promise.

code.description: note_x: refused. note_y: says already paid.

function.name: transfer_to_agent
function.description: Hand over to a person. CALL it when the customer insists on a person.

extraction_schema.name: wrap_up
extraction_schema.description: finished once every item has a promise or a note and you said goodbye, else stay.

extraction_schema.name: topic
extraction_schema.description: difficulty when the customer says a life event stops them paying, else none.

transitions.description: A life event stops them paying
